title: Solo leveling: damage first, self-sustain built in
why: Kill fast alone: the Chain of Torment → Condemnation loop with Earth Punishment crits; Radiant Benediction and Light of Regeneration keep you up.

skills.why: Main damage; with Earth Punishment it always crits and its spec-12 reset removes the cooldown.
Condemnation only hits targets it marks; 4-target DoT for packs.
Held left click: damage plus 110 MP a hit keeps the loop fed.
No-cooldown 4-target filler at the top of the macro column.
Free damage every 30 s; take the AoE spec at 8 for packs.
Biggest single hit when fully charged by hand; 10 by level 38.
10 s 4-target DoT; spec 8 takes 15% off the target's Defense.
Manual self-heal on a 6 s cooldown; spec 8 gives +2 casts.
30 s heal over time that sits in the macro and covers chip damage.
Burst heal and cleanse for elites; spec 8 removes 2 debuffs.
+100 Crit and extra damage on every hit; the best damage passive.
+10.5% Crit Damage; finish it with Wisdom Stone points past the 203 from levels.

stigmas.why: Solo first pick: 30 s DoT nuke, and from level 5 Condemnation crits without cooldown.
Toggle on yourself: +10.5% damage and tolerance for 1 point; keep it out of the macro.
300 s pet aura that attacks with you; recast after each death or teleport.
+20% Attack for 10 s on elites and big pulls; press it by hand.

title: Group dungeon healer: heal first, damage between heals
why: Party healer that still deals damage: heals maxed, Light of Protection for the party, Chain of Torment on the boss, a resurrection slotted.

Party heal and cleanse every 12 s; spec 8 removes 2 debuffs.
30 s party heal over time, kept up by the macro.
Party damage debuff on the boss (−15% Tolerance at spec 12) and Condemnation's enabler.
Damage between heals; chests need your damage contribution too.
Left-click MP source for long fights.
No-cooldown filler on the boss and adds.
Cuts the boss's damage 5% and Defense 15% (spec 8).
Free damage every 30 s; place it within 20 m of the boss.
Turns Attack into Heal Boost, so every Attack stat also heals.
Charged by hand in safe windows for stagger; low priority for a healer.
